atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: define theme variables (design tokens) and the utilities generated from them. Accepts `inline` (use the referenced variable in utilities) and `static` (emit every variable, used or not).

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: add source files or directories to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: define a custom utility class.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: apply a variant (e.g. hover, dark) inside custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: register a custom variant.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inline existing utility classes into custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: load a legacy JavaScript plugin.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: load a legacy JavaScript config file.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: import theme variables without emitting their utilities.
